places-les-coves-abric-de-la-vall-d-ingl.story: A 310 km round trip from Camporrells - roughly 5 h 21 in the saddle. On the way it passes Cova del Tabac, Roc del Rumbau o Roca dels moros, Abric de la Vall d'Ingla and back through Roc del Rumbau o Roca dels moros. The highest point is about 1,850 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Waterfall Way
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 46 km this is Waterfall Way, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
